messages.text: These are the current metrics for your site, so you can see how your club is doing right now.
As a club, your metrics are displayed here, including category views, part clicks and your top categories.
As a merchant you'll see the number of API keys you have created, plus any warnings.
As a partner you'll see your community and merchant onboarding metrics for this month.
As an administrator, you will see community and merchant onboarding metrics for all partners.
